title: Turkish Tomato Soup
description: A delicious and hearty soup inspired by Turkish cuisine, made with fresh tomatoes and spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fresh or canned tomatoes, vegetable broth, Turkish spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of paprika, if desired.
